limits: Fourteen actual browser cases are required, preserving all eleven P01 cases. Fact history/dependency backend tests complement these UI cases. Complete accessibility, entity sharing/finance policies, live provider/runtime recovery and Q04-Q06 remain open; this is no MVP release.

A real alternate-casing test failed then passed, while foreign parent/unowned name remain refused. Fixed browser failure phases are public-safe metadata, all other diagnostics/paths/stdout/cookies discarded; two privacy/report tests observed red before implementation. Existing nine real app cases unchanged.
p01_review: Reviewed actual native typing/mouse submission and server-issued cookies, replacing forced fixture login without reducing existing cases. New failed-login, preparer role, logout/session invalidation and viewer/foreign-history denials compare exact backend outcomes; no fake session endpoint or package patch. Original nine checks retained; eleven scenarios total.
desktop_transition_review: After changing from mobile to desktop, wait for the real work-panel inert state to clear before focusing native inputs. This preserves actual input/focus assertions and avoids interacting while React is applying the media-query transition; no sleeps, mocked state or relaxed outcomes.
